description: Indicadores de projetos e tarefas e suas distribuições por estado.

panels.title: Total de projetos
panels.description: Quantidade de projetos válidos na entidade selecionada.

targets.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: all valid projects in the selected entity scope.
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS value
FROM glpi_projects AS p
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity);

panels.title: Projetos não finalizados
panels.description: Projetos válidos cujo estado não está marcado como finalizado, incluindo os sem estado.

targets.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: valid projects whose state is not marked finished.
-- Projects without a state (projectstates_id = 0) are included as not finished.
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS value
FROM glpi_projects AS p
LEFT JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
       ON ps.id = p.projectstates_id
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
  AND (
      p.projectstates_id = 0
      OR (ps.id IS NOT NULL AND ps.is_finished = 0)
  );

panels.title: Projetos finalizados
panels.description: Projetos válidos cujo estado está marcado como finalizado.

targets.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: valid projects whose state is marked finished.
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS value
FROM glpi_projects AS p
JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
     ON ps.id = p.projectstates_id
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
  AND ps.is_finished = 1;

panels.title: Progresso médio dos projetos
panels.description: Média de percent_done dos projetos válidos; não representa taxa de conclusão.

targets.rawSql:
-- Average stored progress for valid projects; this is not a completion rate.
SELECT AVG(p.percent_done) AS average_progress
FROM glpi_projects AS p
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity);

panels.title: Total de tarefas
panels.description: Quantidade de tarefas válidas em projetos válidos na entidade selecionada.

targets.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: valid tasks belonging to valid projects in the selected project entity scope.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM glpi_projecttasks AS pt
JOIN glpi_projects AS p
     ON p.id = pt.projects_id
WHERE pt.is_deleted = 0
  AND pt.is_template = 0
  AND p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity);

panels.title: Tarefas não finalizadas
panels.description: Tarefas válidas cujo estado não está marcado como finalizado, incluindo tarefas sem estado.

targets.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: valid tasks whose state is not marked finished, including tasks with no state.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM glpi_projecttasks AS pt
JOIN glpi_projects AS p
     ON p.id = pt.projects_id
LEFT JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
       ON ps.id = pt.projectstates_id
WHERE pt.is_deleted = 0
  AND pt.is_template = 0
  AND p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
  AND COALESCE(ps.is_finished, 0) = 0;

panels.title: Tarefas finalizadas
panels.description: Tarefas válidas cujo estado está marcado como finalizado.

targets.rawSql:
-- Current snapshot: valid tasks whose state is marked finished.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM glpi_projecttasks AS pt
JOIN glpi_projects AS p
     ON p.id = pt.projects_id
JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
     ON ps.id = pt.projectstates_id
WHERE pt.is_deleted = 0
  AND pt.is_template = 0
  AND p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
  AND ps.is_finished = 1;

panels.title: Progresso médio das tarefas
panels.description: Média de percent_done das tarefas válidas; não representa taxa de conclusão.

targets.rawSql:
-- Average stored progress for valid tasks in the selected project entity scope.
SELECT AVG(pt.percent_done) AS average_progress
FROM glpi_projecttasks AS pt
JOIN glpi_projects AS p
     ON p.id = pt.projects_id
WHERE pt.is_deleted = 0
  AND pt.is_template = 0
  AND p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity);

panels.title: Projetos por estado
panels.description: Distribuição de projetos válidos por estado. Projetos sem estado aparecem como Sem estado.

targets.rawSql:
-- Distribution of valid projects by state; state 0 is labeled generically.
SELECT CASE
           WHEN p.projectstates_id = 0 THEN 'Sem estado'
           ELSE ps.name
       END AS state_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS project_count
FROM glpi_projects AS p
LEFT JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
       ON ps.id = p.projectstates_id
WHERE p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
GROUP BY state_name
ORDER BY (state_name = 'Sem estado'), state_name;

panels.title: Tarefas por estado
panels.description: Distribuição de tarefas válidas por estado. O filtro Entity é aplicado pela entidade do projeto pai.

targets.rawSql:
-- Distribution of valid tasks by state, scoped through the parent project entity.
SELECT CASE
           WHEN pt.projectstates_id = 0 THEN 'Sem estado'
           ELSE ps.name
       END AS state_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pt.id) AS task_count
FROM glpi_projecttasks AS pt
JOIN glpi_projects AS p
     ON p.id = pt.projects_id
LEFT JOIN glpi_projectstates AS ps
       ON pt.projectstates_id = ps.id
WHERE pt.is_deleted = 0
  AND pt.is_template = 0
  AND p.is_deleted = 0
  AND p.is_template = 0
  AND p.entities_id IN ($entity)
GROUP BY state_name
ORDER BY (state_name = 'Sem estado'), state_name;
